annotations.title: A team's results and next matches

description: Returns the recorded lines of any team the Desk covers, in any league and season, each with an evidenceId you can cite. It also gives the team's record, which is already counted, every team match of the period and its next matches. Call it when someone asks about a named team's matches, results or next match, or before you state a fact about them.

asked.description: The person's question word for word, never paraphrased. Leave it out rather than invent one.

date.description: Optional match day, as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. '2026-02-05'. The rows are then that day's lines, from any season unless `season` is given. Pass it when the question names the day of a match.

includeAllSeasons.description: Set true ONLY when the user explicitly asks about prior years / all history.

phase.description: Optional competition phase: 'sectionals', 'playoffs', 'postseason', or 'regular season'. Pass it when the member names one — a sectional match keeps its REGULAR-SEASON league name in our data, so there is no other way to find it. Omit to return every phase.

season.description: Optional season year to filter to, e.g. 2026

team.description: Team name or partial name to resolve, e.g. 'Tiburon' or 'Mill Valley men's 18'. Or the team's Desk page link or number.
